vault.rules: Notes go to raw/articles as intake for /ingest. Never write or edit anything in wiki/ - the author's own pages. Never touch raw/fieldwork or raw/legacy. Frontmatter: title, source, authors, year, published, created, venue, doi, description, intake: reading-radar, ingested, radar_id, radar_url, radar_score, radar_themes, radar_theme_names, tags. The x-ray step adds xray_confidence and thinker_candidates when it runs; the radar does not declare fields it never fills (panel finding P4-6).
